title: Finite-open comparison map
statement:
Let $\square=(\bar v,v,j_V,j_U,\alpha)$ be a cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]

$$
 \begin{array}{ccc}
 U&\xrightarrow{j_U}&X\\
 v\downarrow&&\downarrow\bar v\\
 V&\xrightarrow{j_V}&Y,
 \end{array}
$$

(in the notation of that node $f=\bar v$, $f'=v$, $g=j_V$, $g'=j_U$, with chosen identification $\alpha:U\xrightarrow{\sim}X\times_YV$), in which $j_U$ and $j_V$ are open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion] and $\bar v$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Use the abelian sheaves $\Ab(T_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], the direct images $u_*$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], the inverse images $u^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and, for an open immersion $j$, the extension by zero $j_!$ with its adjunction $j_!\dashv j^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]; write

$$
 \eta^!_j:\mathrm{id}\longrightarrow j^{-1}j_!,\qquad \varepsilon^!_j:j_!j^{-1}\longrightarrow\mathrm{id}
$$

for the unit and the counit of $j_!\dashv j^{-1}$. Let

$$
 \Ex^0_{\square,F}:j_V^{-1}\bar v_*F\longrightarrow v_*j_U^{-1}F\qquad(F\in\Ab(X_{\Et}))
$$

be the underived exchange morphism of $\square$ [def-weil-pbc-underived-exchange]; since $\bar v$ is finite it is an isomorphism for every $F$ (finite base change, [lemma-weil-pbc-finite-exchange]; Stacks Lemma 0959). For $G\in\Ab(U_{\Et})$ define

$$
 a_G:=\bigl(\Ex^0_{\square,(j_U)_!G}\bigr)^{-1}\circ v_*\bigl(\eta^!_{j_U,G}\bigr):\;
 v_*G\xrightarrow{v_*\eta^!_{j_U,G}}v_*j_U^{-1}(j_U)_!G
 \xrightarrow{(\Ex^0_{\square,(j_U)_!G})^{-1}}j_V^{-1}\bar v_*(j_U)_!G,
$$

and define the *finite-open comparison map* as the adjoint of $a_G$ under $(j_V)_!\dashv j_V^{-1}$:

$$
 \beta_{\bar v,j_V,G}:=\varepsilon^!_{j_V,\,\bar v_*(j_U)_!G}\circ(j_V)_!(a_G):\;
 (j_V)_!v_*G\xrightarrow{(j_V)_!a_G}(j_V)_!j_V^{-1}\bar v_*(j_U)_!G
 \xrightarrow{\varepsilon^!_{j_V}}\bar v_*(j_U)_!G.
$$

The maps $\beta_{\bar v,j_V,G}$, $G\in\Ab(U_{\Et})$, form a natural transformation $\beta_{\bar v,j_V}:(j_V)_!v_*\to\bar v_*(j_U)_!$ of functors $\Ab(U_{\Et})\to\Ab(Y_{\Et})$: $\eta^!_{j_U}$ and $\varepsilon^!_{j_V}$ are natural transformations, $v_*$ and $(j_V)_!$ are functors, $\Ex^0_{\square,-}$ is natural in $F$ [lemma-weil-pbc-underived-exchange-naturality] and hence so is its inverse, and a composite of natural transformations is natural. (This is the map of Stacks Lemma 0GJ1, whose proof identifies $j_V^{-1}\bar v_*(j_U)_!G=v_*j_U^{-1}(j_U)_!G=v_*G$ by Lemmas 0959 and 0F70; $\eta^!_{j_U}$ being an isomorphism, Stacks 0F70, makes $a_G$ an isomorphism but is not needed to define $\beta$.)

blueprint_sketch.statement:
Consider a Cartesian square

$$
\begin{CD}
U @>{j_X}>> X\\
@V{v}VV @VV{\bar v}V\\
V @>{j_Y}>> Y
\end{CD}
$$

with $j_X,j_Y$ open immersions and $\bar v$ finite. For an abelian sheaf
$G$ on $U_{\mathrm{et}}$, define

$$
\beta_{\bar v,j_Y,G}:(j_Y)_!v_*G\longrightarrow
\bar v_*(j_X)_!G
$$

as the morphism adjoint to

$$
v_*G\xrightarrow{\sim}
j_Y^{-1}\bar v_*(j_X)_!G.
$$

The displayed isomorphism is finite base change
$j_Y^{-1}\bar v_*\cong v_*j_X^{-1}$ followed by
$j_X^{-1}(j_X)_!G\cong G$.

split_report.summary: Statement made explicit (not wrong, only vague): beta is written as the composite eps^!_{j_V} o (j_V)_!((Ex^0_{square,(j_U)_!G})^{-1} o v_*(eta^!_{j_U,G})), following the proof of Stacks 0GJ1 (lemma-compatible-shriek-push-finite, etale-cohomology.tex l.11612) and the slopmaster2 Lean AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.finiteOpenComparison (same composite). The identification is finite base change, cited as the closed node lemma-weil-pbc-finite-exchange (Stacks 0959, the lemma Stacks uses; Lean isIso_baseChangeMap_of_isFinite), which holds for an arbitrary cartesian square with chosen identification; the etale-localization nodes lem-weil-pbc-etale-underived-exchange-restriction / lem-weil-pbc-etale-localization-exchange were not used because they are stated only for the literal fibre product with identity identification. Only the invertibility of Ex^0 is needed; that eta^!_{j_U} is an isomorphism (Stacks 0F70) is noted but not used. Naturality in G from lemma-weil-pbc-underived-exchange-naturality (closed) plus naturality of units/counits.
